schoolWindows.label: No classes, the day after Ascension

blocks.name: New Year run
blocks.note: New Year's Day is a Friday, so the free part is only the weekend. Everything after it is bought at full price.

blocks.name: Women's Day week
blocks.note: The Berlin-only holiday on 8 March lands on a Monday, and no Berlin school is off that week, so this is the least contested nine days in the year.

blocks.name: Easter, school week one
blocks.note: Sits inside the Berlin Easter school holidays, so colleagues with school-age children will be asking for exactly these days.

blocks.name: Easter, school week two
blocks.note: Same price as week one and the same school-holiday competition, but it starts on the free Easter weekend instead of ending on it.

blocks.name: Ascension bridge
blocks.note: The one true bridge day of 2027. Berlin schools are already closed on 7 May, so every parent in the office wants it too.

blocks.name: Whitsun week
blocks.note: Berlin schools are off on 18 and 19 May, so a parent reaches the same nine days for two leave days and you need four.

blocks.name: Unity Day Monday
blocks.note: Not a bridge at all. German Unity Day falls on a Sunday in 2027, so this is worth exactly what any other Monday is worth.

blocks.name: Christmas run
blocks.note: Both Christmas holidays fall on the weekend in 2027, so the week between them costs five full leave days. It runs on into 1 and 2 January 2028.

sources: Public holidays and school holiday dates from the Berlin Senate; leave rules from the Bundesurlaubsgesetz.
